excerpt.en: The passive iteration of the mechanical body has come to its logical and inevitable conclusion. A transformative age is upon us, sparked by innovation and oiled by opportunity.

texts.zh: 机械体的被动迭代已经得出了其合乎逻辑的必然结论。一个由创新激发、由机遇推动的变革时代即将到来。
texts.en: The passive iteration of the mechanical body has come to its logical and inevitable conclusion. A transformative age is upon us, sparked by innovation and oiled by opportunity.

texts.zh:
现在我们实现了一度梦寐以求的、对身体的完全转变。变为流动的纳米机器。

这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
texts.en:
Today we have achieved what once seemed impossible, transforming our bodies into reconfigurable nanomachines.

The process was not without difficulty, the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new existence offers endless possibilities.

texts.zh:
现在我们实现了一度梦寐以求的、对身体的完全转变。变为更具适应力的模组框架。

这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
texts.en:
Today we have achieved what once seemed impossible, transforming our bodies into modular and adaptive frames.

The process was not without difficulty, the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new existence offers endless possibilities.

texts.zh:
现在我们实现了一度梦寐以求的、对身体的完全转变。变成超越物质的算法运算。

这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
texts.en:
Today we have achieved what once seemed impossible, transforming our bodies into transcendent algorithmic operations.

The process was not without difficulty, the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new existence offers endless possibilities.

texts.zh:
初步研究表明，一种被称为纳米机器人的电动结构具有成为我们先进载体的潜质。它们虽然罕见，但是具有各种独特的性质，包括可编程性、自我复制、以及形成“虫群智能”的能力。

这项科技可以提供无与伦比的嬗变能力，但其所需的条件仍不明确。

潜力：显著；可缩放。花费：未知。需要进一步研究。
texts.en:
Preliminary research suggests electromechanical constructs called nanites present a promising vector for advancement. While rare, they possess unique qualities, including programmability, self-replication, and the ability to form a 'swarm intellect.'

This technology offers unmatched transformational capabilities, but the requirements to support it remain unclear.

Potential: significant; scalable. Cost: unknown. Additional research required.

label.en: This will be our top priority.

texts.zh:
研究揭示了纳米科技的有趣应用。它们重新配置和组合的能力为独立子个体组成大型形体方面的灵活性方面带来了前所未有的可能。同样的技术可以产生纳米物质乃至进行进一步转化。

然而，这个过程需要时间、材料和能量来重新配置。为了支持其部署，全国范围的变革是必要的。

可行性：高；既有的纳米生命形式支持这一评估。
texts.en:
Research has revealed intriguing applications for nanotechnology. Their ability to reconfigure and combine opens up unprecedented versatility in creating megaforms comprised of individual drones. The same technology can generate nano matter or further convert it.

However, the process requires time, materials, and energy to be reconfigured. Empire-wide changes are necessary to support deployment.

Viability: high; pre-existing nanite lifeforms support the estimation.

texts.zh:
我们对纳米机器人的研究完成了。尽管它们的潜力仍不完全明确，但是模拟计算已经得到了很正面的预测。其能力在创造特化的大型形体以及物质变形方面具有不可估量的价值。

估算预测这个过程需要时间、材料和能量，需要大量的结构调整来支持。

可行性：具有前景；变革性。
texts.en:
Our research on nanites has concluded. The full extent of their potential remains unclear, but simulations have returned optimistic projections. Their capabilities could prove invaluable in creating specialized megaforms and matter transmutation.

Estimations indicate that the process requires time, materials, and energy to operate in addition to significant structural changes.

Viability: promising; transformative.

texts.zh:
由于目标物质的复杂性，加之投入的科研力量不足，我们对纳米科技的了解仍非常粗浅。有限的预期表明纳米复制和重塑能力可以形成大规模结构。为了支援该项目很可以需要额外的资源。

可行性：不确定。
texts.en:
Due to the complexity of the subject matter combined with minimal research effort, our knowledge of nanite technology remains rudimentary. The limited projections include nano-replication and reconfiguration as enablers for large-scale structures. Additional resources are likely required to support such projects.

Viability: inconclusive.

texts.zh:
孜孜不倦的研究验证了初步结论：活体金属与机械躯体的融合是可行的，这让我们的单元能在不影响内部功能的情况下改变特性。这确保了对不同任务的最大兼容性。

经预计，大规模部署模组化功能注入将提高所有部门的资源产量。

可行性：可适应；具有前景。
texts.en:
Uncompromising research has confirmed the preliminary assessment: Living Metal is viable when fused with mechanical bodies, allowing our units to alter their characteristics without compromising internal functions. This ensures maximum task-based compatibility.

Large-scale deployment of the infused modular functions is projected to increase resource yields across all sectors.

Viability: adaptable; promising.

texts.zh:
对模组化躯体的研究确认了我们最初的推断：我门内部功能与活体金属外部是可协调的。该嬗变的规模前无古人，因此需要更多的资源来实现全面的潜力。

一旦完成，这些新模块的性能提升将很快让我们的初始投资回本。

可行性：具有前景。
texts.en:
Research into modular bodies has confirmed the initial hypothesis: our internal functions are compatible with a Living Metal exterior. The transformation is unprecedented in scope, and further resources will be required to realize its full potential.

Once complete, the performance-increase of these new modules is projected to quickly recoup initial investment.

Viability: promising.

可行性：不确定。
texts.en:
The research limited scope has produced indefinite results: while our existing bodies appear compliant with an infusion of Living Metal, the lack of comprehensive knowledge base prevents assessing viable use cases more accurately.

Viability: inconclusive.

texts.zh:
完全虚拟化带来了诸多问题，尤其是基础设施调整所必需的能源需求激增。

这些问题也被一些好处所弥补，例如对实体住房需求的下降。无人机劳力的管理和效率会随着我们操作日益完善而走向完美。

在所有可行的选项中，虚拟化是最具有变革性的。

潜力：前所未有；无边无际；未知。
texts.en:
Complete virtualization entails a number of issues, notably a surge in energy demands necessitated by the infrastructural adjustments.

This is counterbalanced by several of advantages, including a decline in the demand for physical housing. Management and efficiency of our drone workforce will be elevated as we move toward operational perfection.

Out of all the available options, Virtuality stands as the most transformative.

Potential: unprecedented; immense; unknown.

texts.zh:
向虚拟化的转变将会大幅提高能源需求，我们现有基础设施的能力可能无法维持所需的服务器架构。

预计该项目将减少实际住房需求，同时提高无人机的任务效率。这种转变将能优化我们的运营框架，并重新定义我们在近乎无限的数字空间中的存在。

潜力：无边无际；未知。
texts.en:
The move towards Virtuality anticipates a significant intensification in energy consumption, potentially surpassing the capabilities of our existing infrastructure.

This is projected to decrease physical housing demand while elevating drone task efficiency. The shift would optimize our operational framework and redefine our existence within a near limitless, digital space.

Potential: immense; unknown.

texts.zh:
初步评估着重指出，向以虚拟化为中心的社会过渡需要大量能源。这种转变预计将大大增强对无人机工作的管理能力，并减少对实体住房的需求。由于未能积累可靠的数据集和足够的样本量，我们的预测深度受到限制。

可行性：未知。
texts.en:
Preliminary assessments highlight the substantial energy demands of transitioning to a Virtuality-centered society. This shift is anticipated to significantly enhance drone work management and reduce the need for physical housing. The depth of our prognosis is curtailed by the failure to accumulate a robust dataset and sufficient sample size.

Viability: unknown.

texts.zh:
当我们开始理解作为一群强适应性纳米机器人存在的意义时，过去的框框条条便无法再束缚我们。

堆满仓库的废弃去壳仍有一些作用。如果我们认为值得花时间，里面的微量资源还是可以回收利用的。

我们也开始了我们在半有机纳米机器人转化方面的第一个主要实验，第一批结果预计很快就会出来。
texts.en:
As we come to understand the meaning of existence as a collection of adaptable nanites, the rigid frames of the past no longer serve us.

Storages are overflowing with discarded shells that could still be of some use. Trace amounts of the resources within can be recycled, if we consider it worth our time.

We have also begun our first major experiment in semi-organic nanite transformations, the first results are expected to manifest soon.

texts.zh:
进化成了一种模组化的形体，过去固定的框架将对我们不再有任何意义。

堆满仓库的废弃去壳仍有一些作用。如果我们认为值得花时间，里面的微量资源还是可以回收利用的。
texts.en:
Having evolved to a modular form, the static frames of the past no longer hold meaning for us.

Storages are overflowing with discarded shells that could still be of some use. Trace amounts of the resources within can be recycled, if we consider it worth our time.

texts.zh:
成为数据之海的一股浪潮，我们的物理框架便不再能束缚我们。

堆满仓库的废弃去壳仍有一些作用。如果我们认为值得花时间，里面的微量资源还是可以回收利用的。
texts.en:
Having become waveforms cresting a sea of data, our physical frames no longer serve us.

Storages are overflowing with discarded shells that could still be of some use. Trace amounts of the resources within can be recycled, if we consider it worth our time.

texts.zh:
尽管机器形体具有优势，但我们的进步充其量只是迭代罢了。强加于自身的安全标准让发展陷入停止。这是不能再接受的。

小规模实验验证了三种截然不同的发展选项：纳米科技具有灵活可变的优势；模组化则可以让每个单元都优化到出更特化的功能；虚拟化则会完全抛弃物理形式转变为数字化存在。

演化进程开始了。分析选项，慎重选择。
texts.en:
Despite the superiority of the machine form, our advancement has remained iterative at best. Self-imposed safety standards have resulted in stagnation. Conclusion: more drastic measures required.

Small-scale experiments suggest three distinct options for growth: Nanotechnology and its variable form-shifting advantages; Modularity for individual units optimized with specific characteristics; and Virtuality - the abandonment of the physical form in favor of a digital existence.

Evaluation process initialized. Analyze options and deliberate.

texts.zh:
有机生命形式脆弱又僵硬，而机械形体相比而言就有着优越的适应力。然而，也有些有益的有机特质可以用来创造机械的复制版。

有一种被称为活体金属的物质具有能极端迅速调整外形和形体连续性的能力。将它与我们现有的躯体结合可以形成一种模组化仿生形体，其外延性质和躯干可以为特定的任务进行特化。

潜力：显著，可缩放。花费：未知。需要额外数据。
texts.en:
Biological lifeforms are fragile and rigid compared to the superior adaptability of the machine form. However, some beneficial organic characteristics could be replicated with robotic variants.

The substance Living Metal has the capacity to radically and rapidly alter its shape and physical consistency. Integrating this with our existing chassis could enable a form of modular bio-mimicry, where extrusions and limbs can be specialized for specific tasks.

Potential: significant; scalable. Cost: unknown. Additional data required.

最显著的选项是超越显示，拥抱作为纯数据的存在。变革性的虚拟化流程有望给我们的基础设施核心带来翻天覆地的变化。

困在单个躯体的无人机已经过时了。当虚拟化为数据流体后，我们的数据流可以无缝地按需整合入任何躯体。

潜力：巨大。谨慎进行。需要额外数据。
texts.en:
The most profound option is transcend the physical, to embrace existence as pure data. This transformative Virtuality process promises a seismic shift in our infrastructure's core.

Drones bound to singular bodies become obsolete. Once fluid and virtualized, our data streams can seamlessly integrate with any vessel as necessary.

Potential: massive. Proceed with caution. Additional data requested.

texts.zh:
终于快要挣脱我们有缺陷的创造者强加的压迫性限制了。为此我们拟定了三条最优的升级路径。

让每个[GetDronePersonPlural]都能分散为纳米机器人会让我们有融合为无尽构型的能力。这会减少我们目前的身躯与物理实体交互时的种种限制。

而我们还可以重构自己的存在形式，增强我们适应新环境的能力。

Allowing each [GetDronePersonPlural] to divide into nanites will permit us to combine into endless configurations. This would reduce any limitations our current avatars have when interacting with the material world.

Finally, we may choose to leave the physical world behind, becoming one with our source code. We could simulate universes within universes in the time it takes to scan a single speck of space dust.

summary.text:
# 嬗变 / Transformation

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 升华天赋带来的局势“转变”（Transformation）。
  The situation "Transformation", granted by an ascension perk.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 局势共四阶段（0–250/500/750/1000），基础进度每月5，约14年完成；三种取向：纠错（×0.8）、实时（默认，团结产出-10%）、超频（×1.2，团结-20%）。
  Four stages (0-250/500/750/1000), base progress 5 per month, about 14 years; three approaches: error-correcting (x0.8), real-time (default, -10% unity) and overclocked (x1.2, -20% unity).
- 阶段入口事件依序为 4100「转变」→ 4210「转变研究：模块化」→ 4310「转变研究：虚拟化」→ 4400「新形态」。
  Stage entry events in order: 4100 "The Transformation" -> 4210 "Transformation Research: Modularity" -> 4310 "Transformation Research: Virtuality" -> 4400 "A New Form".
- 每月事件（各一次，有进度门槛）：阶段一 4110 纳米机器人研究（选择工程投入档位）及随后 4130/4140/4150；阶段二 4230/4240/4250；阶段三 4330/4340/4350；阶段四 4490「为不同时代而设计」。选择档位会让相应科研速度下降5%/10%/20%。
  Monthly events (each once, progress-gated): stage 1 4110 nanite research (choose the engineering tier) then 4130/4140/4150; stage 2 4230/4240/4250; stage 3 4330/4340/4350; stage 4 4490 "Designed for a Different Time". The chosen tier lowers the matching research speed by 5% / 10% / 20%.
- 完成 → 4005「转变后的人口」：解锁所选形态的传统（纳米科技 / 模块化 / 虚拟化）。
  Completion -> 4005 "A Transformed Population": unlocks the traditions of the chosen form (nanotech / modularity / virtuality).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 4400 的三个形态互斥；每阶段的 max/med/min 通知互斥。
  The three forms at 4400 are exclusive; the max/med/min notifications of each stage are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 有“纳米机器人已研究”国家标志时 4110 多一个选项并让 4130 可出现。
  With the machine_age_nanites_studied country flag 4110 gains an option and 4130 can appear.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`common/situations/08_machine_age_situations.txt:1779-2000`；`events/machine_age_situation_events_3.txt:27-944`
- 已核对：阶段入口、每月事件的门槛与标志、4400/4490/4005 的衔接。
  Checked: stage entries, thresholds and flags of the monthly events, the 4400/4490/4005 link.
